description:
Panel indicator showing the current temperature (optionally with a weather icon). Popup menu with an hourly forecast (temperature, UV index, precipitation probability, color-coded temps) and a 7-day daily view. Favourite locations searchable by name, postal code or coordinates, plus automatic location via GNOME Location Services or IP. Celsius/Fahrenheit, 12/24-hour clock. Weather data from Open-Meteo.

Based on Chips Weather by ninjabucket.
name: Crisps Weather
